title: Recover missing draft JSON and select the last valid draft
answers: Why did the support reply use example JSON?
What happens when the draft agent only says it is waiting?
How should support draft agent text be parsed?
body:
Symptom: A support reply uses an example instead of the final answer, or the agent returns a status sentence without a draft.
Root cause: Agent text can contain example or ticket JSON before the answer, or no usable draft object; products/conversations/backend/temporal/ai_reply/activities/draft.py:_parse_draft and _draft_from_session handle these cases.
Fix pattern: Scan JSON objects and validate candidates in reverse order, accepting the last valid draft; if none exists, send one JSON-only follow-up and parse it the same way.
Constraints: A valid first response needs no follow-up. An empty first turn raises before a session is available, so it cannot be nudged; failed or unusable follow-ups go through _give_up.
Timing invariant: _DRAFT_NUDGE_POLL_SECONDS allows two 90-second nudge polls; these and the initial poll must fit within the draft activity's 20-minute timeout in products/conversations/backend/temporal/pipeline.py:SupportReplyWorkflow.
applies: Parsing and recovering raw agent responses for support reply drafts.
